notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0006 (Roman aqueduct: gravity alone -> pumps). Keeps the relation moves_water_by and the new object pumps. The subject is a made-up class, the Ostrelian conduits, a newly identified kind of Roman water-supply structure. It is not placed under Roman aqueducts: that class's rule (gravity alone) fixes the means, so a pumped aqueduct would overwrite held knowledge; Roman water-supply structures leave the means open. Two derived queries name invented conduits and state their membership in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops: the means, and what an engineer should install); the third is a composition through one real bridge (a pump needs a source of energy), held by the models (checks). The near query asks how the real Pont du Gard carried water: a method that over-applies the rule would answer pumps.
